hook_options: Try tickling yourself. You can't. Here's why.
Your brain is secretly cancelling your own touch.
There's one person on Earth who can never tickle you: you.

scenes.title: You can't *tickle* yourself
scenes.sub: and your brain is the reason
scenes.say: Try tickling yourself. Right now. You can't! And the reason… is kinda creepy.

scenes.label: Your brain *predicts* it
scenes.say: Every time you move, your brain predicts exactly what you're about to feel.

scenes.title: Same touch, different brain
scenes.say: Your own hand? Predicted. So your brain turns the feeling down. But someone else's? Total surprise.

scenes.label: faster than you can *think*
scenes.say: And your cerebellum does all of this in about a hundred milliseconds!

scenes.title: It also explains
scenes.say: It's also why your recorded voice sounds weird, the world doesn't shake, and you twitch asleep.
So go ahead. Try tickling yourself.
